a.text: You must be bored of nights like this.
The ones where the damp, cold fog creeps up on the roaring fires of the furnace. Ash permeates the air, its choking stench a constant assault on the nostrils.
Hard to imagine being able to sleep like this. Cramming a whole day's worth of work into an all-too-short dream, before awakening to find that things remain unchanged.
A black city, black stones, black clouds, and a blood-red flame ensconced in a furnace, unchanging since time immemorial.
No, this is not particularly conducive to a good night's sleep. At the very least, something should fill the dreary silence.
Something like...

steps.text: 9:30 P.M. \ Overcast
Kazdel, Residential District

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: The fire of the Soul Furnace~♪ Is Kazdel's sun truest~♪

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: It dries our childrens' clothes~♪ Warms our warriors' hearts~♪

steps.name: Docile Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Stamps hoof to the beat)

steps.name: Docile Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo~ Moo~

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: There's no better place in Kazdel~♪ Than the plaza by the Furnace~♪ Those stingy little hawkers~♪ Haggle with some loser mercs~♪

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Who the *Sarkaz swearing* do you think you're mouthing off about?! Your singing stinks! Going on all day like a broken horn.

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: We didn't lose to the Victorians! We had to—what were those again?

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: The fighters console themselves~♪ Calling it tactical retreat~♪

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Right! It was a lactical defeat.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: But even his burdenbeasts know~♪ His knapsack is now empty~♪ His daughter's not seen him in years~♪ Now~ looks~ at~ him~ funny~♪
The crowd warming by the furnace node begins to laugh.
Suddenly, an ear-piercing sound rends the air. The laughter abruptly stops.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: Err... The warrior's an angry manglerbeast~♪ His hands, like claws, reach for my throat♪ Won't someone come to save me... (croak)♪

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: Oh, she will! Over here my savior comes—♪

steps.name: Overwhelmed Girl
steps.text: The ceremony starts in five minutes! Knock it off! What did I say about putting your music sheets in the cordon, Snapstring? Get your clutter away from the Furnace already!

steps.name: Overwhelmed Girl
steps.text: And you, Steelskull, back off from the cordon a bit. Unless you want your burdenbeast buddies to burn their fur?

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Oh, it's you, Nymph. Joining in on the fun?

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Relax, this broken furnace only spits out sparks. I'd know better than you, right? Settle down.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: My head nearly got crushed~♪ But now I do recall~♪ I wanted to give the souls in the Furnace~♪ One last farewell song~♪

steps.name: Docile Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Calmly warms itself by the fire)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I get it, not everyone's thirty-something like you. But things are about to change The Furnace used to burn revenants for power, but we're about to switch to a new source of energy.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi says tonight's ceremony will be really, really important to get the revenants to come out. If something goes wrong and the Furnace goes 'boom'—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Steelskull! Are you even listening?

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: I saw much worse out there! Even the Feline's cannons barely even singed these guys, so what's a rinky-dink oven going to do, even if it blows?

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: The fire's just right tonight. Might as well get my blade reforged.

steps.name: Burdenbeast by the Fire
steps.text: (Harrumphs happily)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Why... won't you guys just listen?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Fine! I'll do it myself!

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Hey, don't tug on my burdenbeasts! They—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Waahh!

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: They'll think you're playing with them and knock you into the dirt.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: The unreasonable is now reasonable~♪ You bully so you don't get bullied~♪ Our ancestors've seen enough~♪ They're about to go flying free~♪

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: That's dumb, Sarkaz don't bully Sarkaz.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: (Disdainful whistle)

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ow... That hurt...

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: The plaza's packed. Are you really going to tell everyone to go home one by one? You'll need more than one set of legs.

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Can't you just, I dunno, use your Djall powers to scare them all off in one go?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No, nuh-uh! That's simply out of line! Sarkaz don't bully Sarkaz, remember? Also, you should never, ever treat a Djall's powers so lightly!

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Okay okay, no wonder you're the kindest Djall... no, the nicest Sarkaz in all of Kazdel, Nymph. Now go break a leg.
Nymph looks behind her at the furnace node plaza, filled to the brim with raucous singing, peddlers hawking their wares, and hammers beating on weapons.
In the distance, the Soul Furnace towers above, belching out an acrid, thick black smoke. A careful listener could hear the faint screeching of the revenants.
For the past two hundred years, day after day, it has sent energy to the furnace nodes, which then pass that energy on to the countless homes in Kazdel.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I don't know what will happen to the revenants after the ceremony... Come to think of it, I don't know what a revenant even looks like.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *sigh* I promised Ermi I'd make sure the people in this neighborhood were safe before the ceremony started.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Why can't the Sarkaz in Kazdel just do as they're told...
What is the meaning of this? Are you going to let me finish reading or not?
Another fit? Oh good, why don't you milk this out all night? It's not as if you're the one paying for the ceremony, are you?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Enough. I don't like being here and inhaling these noxious gases either. If you could all be a tad bit more cooperative, we could get this over with and be on our separate ways.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I shall just carry on from where I was interrupted, not that any of you are listening in the first place.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: 'The duty of the Soul Furnace nears a close, the torments of thine burning body hereto shall end.'

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: 'Thus under the eyes of the myriad souls do I pray...'

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: If I could offer a comment, though the ceremonial recitation states 'pray', you ought to know that this is more of a... notice.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Also, 'Await these rites in peace, spread not thine suffering' means 'pipe down and don't cause a ruckus'. Things are rather hectic in the city right now, and if you could just wait until I have a moment spare, I'll give you all the pomp and circumstance you need.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: When the time comes, do as you will, whether that means going home or staying here to help. Hell, get into a fight, if that's what you want. Just don't tear down the city walls while you're at it.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Did you get all that? Speak up if you did.

a.text: Your rites mean nothing... We have waited and suffered for too long!
You threw us into this furnace...
Too long! The burning! The scorching!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Yes, yes, I understand you've been through a lot. Just to be fair, I didn't throw you in there, and we the Sarkaz today are not ungrateful.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: What we're doing at this very moment is trying to get you guys out. So pipe down already!

a.text: Millions upon millions of nights... Traveling through the dark, my kindreds, my screams, have been drowned!
Young Lich! A mere child—
Insincere! Insolent! Ignorant!
Still your tongue, cease your lies, and get thee gone!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: *Sarkaz swearing* You better do as you're told if you know what's good for you! I've tried to keep this civilized!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Act your age already, you're over ten thousand years old—
As the wizened Lich rants and raves, a stray glob of slag splashes across his face.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Master! Is everything alright?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: The gauge indicates that the Furnace's energy output isn't stable. Is something the matter with the ceremony? Do you require my assistance?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough*!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Stay back! You're not needed yet!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: *tirade of Sarkaz swearings* Mark my words, if these geriatric fools aren't taken care of by tonight, I'll be Manfred's personal shoeshine!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough*!

steps.name: Military Commission Soldier
steps.text: General, you've been standing guard all day. You should take a rest.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Now's the pivotal moment of the ceremony. Nothing can be allowed to go wrong.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Take your positions. If you notice anything out of the ordinary, report to me at once.

steps.name: Military Commission Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It seems Kazdel is still somewhat chilly this time of year.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Hey, you really ready to meet your old pals?

steps.name: Elder Revenant
steps.text: Today is a crossroads... The end of an endless history.

steps.name: Elder Revenant
steps.text: Their sacrifice may not have been willing, but it was their agony and torment that fueled Kazdel for thousands of years. For that, they have my utmost respect.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Not willing? You were the one who caught them and threw them into the Furnace in the first place. You really think you'll manage a nice, peaceful chat with them?

steps.name: Elder Revenant
steps.text: Her Highness has restored my sanity and given me clarity. My mind is no longer shrouded in haze, my heart no longer gripped by senseless rage.

steps.name: Elder Revenant
steps.text: Let me see them. I'll try to quell their anger. It was I who began this age of suffering. It is only fitting that I end it.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Here's hoping you can.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: Their souls are roasting in the Furnace~♪ They've got emotions of every sort~♪ Will they really be ready to wave goodbye~♪ To their old metal home~♪

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Hey, you! Stop gawping at the Furnace like an idiot and start gawping at my wares like a genius! If you don't like 'em, you've got no taste! Come take a look, girl... Oh, you again?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Fatwallet! About last time—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Oh no, are you hurt? You should watch where you're running.
The girl makes a face and sticks her tongue out at Nymph before peeling off into the distance.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: While you're short of customers, Fatwallet, you need to get your stuff outside the cordon. I can help.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Eh, fine by me. Not like I've got any customers.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: That's great! I'll get started, then.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Gonna need payment first though. If I have to move my whole stall, then you're gonna have to rent the spot from me.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: R-Rent? But this is just an empty spot by the road...

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Well, it's mine now. It's a good spot by the Furnace, lots of slackers hanging about. It's warm, too. You can get your three squares a day here, without having to waste energy at home. It won't be cheap.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Anyway, that's enough free talk. You want anything more out of me, it's gonna cost ya. You're getting in the way of business here.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hey—
Nymph looks to the Soul Furnace with worry. It might be her imagination, but the smoke appears to be getting thicker.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: A job only I can do?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sure, Ermi! My purse has been pretty light lately, so this is a lifesaver! What do you need from me? Repairs? Looking after burdenbeasts? I can do a little bit of everything.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Oh, I would never task you with something so trivial, o kind and considerate Nymph. It'd be a terrible waste of talent.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Let me think... What should this position be called... Neighborhood... Officer?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Neighborhood Officer?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Alright, I may have just come up with that title. But it's really important! You'll be the friendly neighborhood solver of any tricky issues.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: As you know, ever since that Victorian business, we've been dreadfully spread thin, and maintaining order in the streets is becoming more difficult by the day.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: But when it comes to making sure everyone's safe, you're one of the best. You're Kazdel's most considerate Djall, after all.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I... I am?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But... Okay! I get the idea!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Make sure everyone's safe... Just leave it to me, Ermi! I'll do my very best!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Fatwallet, if I rent this spot from you, you'll move outside the cordon, right? That's what you said. Let me see, my...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Where's my purse?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, it's definitely on me somewhere... I must have put it in another pocket... How could this be...? Maybe I forgot to bring it with me when I left the house...?

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Looks like I've got a fool on my hands. Maybe you're a nice, honest soul? Nope, there's no such thing. So a fool you must be.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: My purse is gone... And the ceremony's almost over now...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Fatwallet! Please please please move your stall away, please? If you don't move, then Steelskull won't either, then everyone's going to get burned by the Furnace.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Ugh, that big lummox still holding a grudge? All I did was store my goods in his house while he was out fighting. Not like he said I couldn't.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: I looked after that daughter of his for years! Him? He slinks back from Victoria, tail between his legs, completely empty-handed. You think I babysit for free?!

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: You looked after her? You raised her to be a *Sarkaz swearing* thief! I gave her a name so I could send her off to learn to read and write! And you ruined all that!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, please stop fighting. The Furnace... the cordon... there's no time!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ah! That's my purse! Please don't run—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ow!
Nymph is tripped up by the girl and lands face-first in a puddle of mud. Bystanders chuckle as they help her up, and covered from head to toe in muck, she glances dejectedly at the quarreling duo.
Everywhere she looks, people are going about their business as usual within the cordon. Even the pushover wandering singer is sitting cross-legged, composing a new song by the light of the furnace.

steps.name: Guitar-Playing Singer
steps.text: Oh what to do, what to do~♪ What she wants~ Is really simple~♪♪ But now she finds herself~ In a pickle♪

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: You done yet? What's taking so long? Wasn't the last few times real smooth?

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: If you can't hack it, just step down and let me. Hey—

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: *sigh* Who even let you up here, Wiš'adel? Did I not instruct Ermengarde to keep everyone away from the ceremony?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: It's bad enough that you're here, did you really have to bring that one along too?

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: You've been floating up there forever and nothing's happened. I came because I was worried about you!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: You came because you wanted to rubberneck! As for being worried about me, best you worry about yourself.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: What's to worry about? I wasn't the one who stuffed our ancestors in the fire to roast like sweet potatoes.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Good. Those who dare speak to a revenant in such a manner tend to meet an unhappy end.

a.text: The murderer... returns.
Is it him? He must... pay! MAKE HIM PAY!
Pain, agony, forsaken... all his debts! How dare he...
Silence, all of you! Listen, to what he has to say!

steps.text: Debt? I owe you nothing.
It was all... a necessary price to pay.

a.text: Then why did you not stay?
Then why do you not throw them in too?
Then why did you return?!

steps.text: I am here to pick you up.
Your duty is at an end.
I've come to welcome you, as you leave this cramped purgatory.

a.text: Ridiculous! Laughable!
It was you who threw us in here! You who left alone!
How dare you? HOW DARE YOU?
How dare you return? So brazen and condescending?
I will see you pay the price! I will see everything burn in the raging flames of this furnace as we did!

steps.text: I understand your anger. I will face your wrath.
But now, I just want you to come up and see the Kazdel today.
Come and see. See the city you've devoted yourselves to. It is proof that you lived—

a.text: You have no place to say that to us!
No, wait... You... the one we called the eldest of revenants...
Why have you become like... this?

steps.text: Hah...
You need not feel sorrow for me.
My shattered soul has been burned away. Nothing is left.

a.text: Eldest of revenants... Why...?
Why are you in a cannon?
No, it's more like a Sankta gun.
Our vaunted elder, trapped inside a Sankta gun.
Haha... Hahahaha!
Hahahahaha...

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: What're they arguing about, old man? Translate for me.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Hmm... I'm not entirely sure it could be called an argument.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Huh? Why so quiet all of a sudden? They hashed things out already?

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Pffeh... Pffh! Maybe don't blast ash in your guest's face?

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: What the hell was that?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Based on my prior dealings with these fellows, that would be the equivalent of spitting in your face.

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: Me? What did I do?!

steps.name: Wiš'adel
steps.text: *Sarkaz swearing*! Hey, you old farts! What gives?!
I... This...
You... are all...
BEYOND REASONING!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Military Commission Soldier
steps.text: General! Our cannons! They've started charging on their own! I think it's the remnants of the revenant fragment in the core, it's—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Starting up our guns, is it? What's the target?

steps.name: Military Commission Soldier
steps.text: If I'm reading this right... It's the Soul Furnace!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Quick! Cut all power—
Fantastical lights explode and streak across the night sky like a rain of fire.
Cold, weary, and unchanging as ever, Kazdel silently absorbs their fiery descent.
There is always someone awake, yearning for a glimpse of something different from the small patch of night sky outside their window.
Something like... a sudden, violent burst of fireworks.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: The Furnace!

steps.name: Faint Distant Shouting
steps.text: Who! Fired! That! Cannon?!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: My roof! Darn it, I just fixed it up a few days ago. Where'd that big rock even come from...? And what's that burning smell?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ow! My head... hot hot hot!

a.text: Dang it...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? Wh-What was that?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: No, I don't have time to worry about the roof...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Everyone, please listen! That accident is definitely connected to the ceremony. The Soul Furnace could restart at any moment. For your safety, please evacuate outside the cordon immediately!
Clang! Clang! Clang! The mercenary mending his weapon keeps hammering away without even looking up.

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: Come one, come all, come and take a look. You're blind if you don't buy anything—

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You... You all really...!

a.text: Just *Ancient Sarkaz swearing* die already.

steps.text: Steelskull's hammer stops mid-swing, Fatwallet's shouting stops mid-sentence, and the wandering singer's guitar string snaps mid-pluck.

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Girl... What did you just say?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I said!

a.text: Are you deaf?

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: Wha... What?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: For the sake of everyone's safety...

a.text: Heheheh...
Burn—burn—I'll burn you all into ashes—

steps.name: Weapon-Maintaining Mercenary
steps.text: H-Hey, calm down... What're you coming over here for? My clothes and the burdenbeasts are fla—err, what was it—flammable!

steps.name: Crafty Merchant
steps.text: He's right, don't do anything crazy!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Get behind the cordon now, or else...

a.text: Cowards who flee from battle!
Thieves who steal from their own!
Lowlifes who indulge in pleasure!
Idlers who shirk their duties!
I'll kill you all! Kill! KILL!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Or else...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Huh? Where'd everyone go?

One by one, the plaza's crowd turned their heads, staring at Nymph in disbelief. Steelskull frantically tries to drag his burdenbeasts out of the cordon, while Fatwallet packs up her stall with surprising speed for someone her age.
Nymph feels something bump into her belly. The girl who stole her purse shoves it back into her hands, then runs off as fast as she can.
The wandering singer now stands meekly outside the cordoned area with his sheets under his arm, as if he has been there the whole time.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wow, that's...
Nymph scratches her head, setting free the glimmering fragment that had fallen into her hair. It still retains the heat of the Furnace it was so unduly ejected from.
As it tumbles out of her hair, the strange voice in her head cuts off.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nymph! Can you hear me?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nymph! Nymphy! Hey!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Is that you, Ermi? How come I can't see you?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Look at the mirror in the little box I gave you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wow, Ermi, how'd you get inside the mirror?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Didn't I tell you when I gave it to you? You must have missed the instructions I wrote again.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Lich creations aren't so easy to understand. Besides, if I ever need to use it, you'll help me.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: So, what's going on? I saw a really big explosion over by the Furnace!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Something went awry at the ceremony, and now the ancestors are throwing a fit. Get this... the revenant on the airship got into a fight with those in the Furnace!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I'm fine, a little explosion like that couldn't hurt me. My master's still counting on me to run errands for him, though I have a bit more on my plate than I can handle.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: As for the Furnace... It's still intact, and there haven't been any further issues. But the explosion caused another problem, and I miiiiight have to ask you for help again!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I'm just glad you're alright. Whatever you need help with, just say the word.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: We need to hunt down all the bits of slag that got ejected from the Furnace and see if they have any revenant fragments in them.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Revenant... fragments? Are they dangerous? A lot of people here have been picking up shards of stuff that fell from the sky after the explosion.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: They are! Which is why master wants me to find them as quickly as possible. The revenants in the Furnace are restless now that they're missing some of their kind.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: As for the revenant fragments that are scattered, they're like ticking time bombs. We don't know when they're going to stir up trouble.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: But don't worry too much. Judging by the number of revenants still inside the Furnace, only a handful of fragments have a revenant riding along. Fewer than ten, in fact.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *phew* Finally, some good news. I was thinking about how long it'd take to find every single bit that fell from the sky.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Well, unfortunately, that's the difficult part of all this. We have no idea where these fragments fell. They could be anywhere in Kazdel, really.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: So, what do the ones with the revenants look like?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: To be honest, I haven't had a proper look at one either. It shouldn't be too hard to identify something with a revenant riding inside it, though. It'll influence the emotions and senses of the people around it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Would they happen to be surrounded by wisps of smoke? Maybe they sparkle and flash too?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Yeah! Something like that!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Then you might want to look at this and see if it's what you're looking for... Though I haven't felt it influence my emotions or anything.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Are you at home? I'll head over right now. Whatever you do, don't give that thing to anyone else. We're lucky you're a Djall!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ah, okay! I'm by the furnace node near my house, so come as quick as you can. Hmm... This little rock sure is hot.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi, you're back! What did your master say?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: The good news is that it really was a revenant fragment. Master's already placed it back in the Furnace. The bad news is that we might have been too quick with retrieving it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Why's that a bad thing? Shouldn't we be putting them back right away?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Wait, did your master... compliment you?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Even you have him figured out by now. Yeah, he did, and every time he does, he's almost always building up to bad news!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: You know how I have to inspect goods going in and out of Kazdel every day, organize patrols, arrange repairs for the holes in the Furnace, and even inventory all the stuff he brought back from Leithanien, right?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: He's already running me ragged, and now he wants me to...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi! Did you try telling him that you're already swamped and that someone else should go gather the fragments?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I did tell him that! I even told him the only reason we found this first one so quickly was you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: And then? Did he change his mind?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that... Wait, Ermi! Hey—!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Nymph~

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Help me out again, last time I swear. I really have too much to handle and that old tool doesn't really care. Please, you're the only one I can count on now...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: You just need to find all the fragments and bring them back. I'll give you a nice, big reward if you do.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I know you don't really lack anything, but I guarantee it'll be something you really want. And... it's something only I can give you, not even my master could.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Well, don't keep me guessing. Just say what it is and I'll think it over.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I can't tell you too much at the moment, but don't you worry, we Liches are a generous people.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Hmph, is that really the proper attitude to ask for help? Anyone else would have walked away, but not this silly Djall. She just lets you walk all over her.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: So fine, I'll help you find these fragments, but do you have a map that can show where they are, Ermi? The kind with the little black dots floating around?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Do you think Liches can just conjure things from thin air? Why would I have something so strange?

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: But you have a point, you'd be chasing your own tail if I just sent you off to find the fragments with no help.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Not to mention that you don't have anything that could actually contain the revenant fragments... Pass me that box thing of yours while I think for a second.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: I'll need some time to give this a few upgrades. Head home and rest for now. Once I'm done, I'll come find you.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Eh? I thought this was a super urgent task.

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Oh, I wouldn't go that far. And once you have the right tool, you'll save far more time than the few hours it'll take me to make it.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Fine, but I still hope you can think over the map thing a bit more. I'll put my box over here. See you later, Ermi!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: A way to detect revenants... To isolate them... What if I dismantled this part...? No, that won't work...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Ermi? I'm heading back now. I'll wait for your good news!

steps.name: Ermengarde
steps.text: Eh? Oh, alright, bye-bye!

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Liches are always so quick to jump into thinking mode. I really hope she doesn't become like her master one day...

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *yawn* I've got important things to do tomorrow, so I'd better get some rest.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I wonder how many people will dream about those fireworks tonight?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: *pant* *pant* It's still so hot... like trying to hold a roast sweet potato fresh out of the oven. Can't imagine how hot it must be in the Furnace.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: It's nice to meet you... ancestor sir? I don't quite know what to call you. You must have been burning in the Furnace since my grandparents were still little. You really gave it good to that crowd just now.
Nymph walks over to a quiet corner of the plaza and sits down on some steps.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I should probably put you back where you belong, but getting to meet you was something really special... I'd better tell you what I need to say quick.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I've always known you were real, ever since I was young. Everyone said you were just stories to scare little kids, but I always believed.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Back then, there was a Babel camp right by my doorstep. Mom and Dad never let me wander too far, so I was always looking for the camp's doctors to play with.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: My favorite fairy tale was the future the Babel doctors told me about.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: And then... My Babel friends left without warning. One day I'd go look for them as usual, and there was just the field.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: I was really sad, so I cried and cried at the furnace node in the plaza, because everyone told me the underground pipes connected to it would carry my voice all the way to the great, big Soul Furnace.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Now that I've seen, or heard you, I feel so happy. You really do exist and you've been protecting us and all of Kazdel this whole time and—

a.text: Noisy.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Sorry!
Nymph's eyes widen as a shadow slowly seeps out of the shimmering slag. It is barely a wisp, as faint as a cicada's wings, but at least he doesn't sound as angry as before.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: Shabby.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You mean our neighborhood? Haha, well, I think it's kinda nice, once you get used to it.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: Barely any improvement.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Improvement? Oh, you mean compared to two hundred years ago.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Right... You've been in the Furnace all that time. Maybe this is your first time out.
Nymph stretches out her hand that the slag is resting on, allowing him a clearer view of the plaza. The first view he's had in two hundred years that did not include flames.

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: See, ancestor revenant sir? This is where we live nowadays.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: What's that sound?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Snapstring's singing. That instrument he's holding is cobbled together from scraps. It looks like a guitar, but I don't know what it's actually called.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: And the mercenary?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: You mean Steelskull? He's had a few drinks, and now he's dancing around his burdenbeast battle buddies.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: What of the army?

steps.name: Nymph
steps.text: Uh... Do you mean the Military Commission? Maybe, umm... Do you see that big airship flying overhead? I've heard they're up there.

steps.name: Slag Shadow
steps.text: Rest—
After a long period of silence, that is the only word the slag says. Nymph doesn't quite understand the meaning.
Not too far away, the wandering singer plucks at his instrument and begins to sing a song of farewell, as promised.
